name: aero-eco-city-figure
prompt: A high, wide establishing view over a spotless green utopia at golden hour, like a glossy mid-2000s brochure render of tomorrow: smooth white towers with rounded, leaf-shaped silhouettes rise in tiers, every terrace spilling with lush gardens and small trees; slim white wind turbines stand on rolling lime-green hills behind them, blades softly blurred mid-turn; clear glass domes full of palms catch the sun; a streamlined white monorail glides along a curved elevated track; an aqua-turquoise lagoon so clean it looks like polished glass mirrors the towers. Everything is pristine and shiny, slightly over-perfect, with candy-bright saturation, crisp specular highlights on every curved surface, a soft white-and-cyan lens flare near the top corner and faint floating bokeh rings. Not one person anywhere in the city: empty plazas, empty train, empty paths. In the lower foreground, small in frame, a smooth white curving walkway with a glossy rail, and on it a single figure standing perfectly still, square to the camera, arms at its sides, in a dark grey knitted balaclava that covers the entire head with no openings at all for eyes, nose or mouth; a large white ring of stitching encircles the whole face, and inside the ring, high up on the right-hand side of the picture, sits one small red triangle with softly rounded corners, point downward; dark gloves, plain dark clothes, no skin visible anywhere. Next to its shoulder one iridescent soap bubble hangs motionless in the warm air. Far off at the very edge of the sky, low on the horizon behind the hills, a thin band of dull grey haze is quietly spreading into the blue. Vertical portrait composition, deep focus, warm honeyed sunlight from the left, palette of sky blue, lime green, white, aqua and gold, with that one cold grey smudge. No text, no lettering, no logos anywhere in the image. Thanks.
